Nanopb message structs and tags for block test context, effects, and fixture data.

# Purpose
This nanopb header defines Protocol Buffers message types for block execution test data in the `org.solana.sealevel.v1` package. It declares the C structs, field tags, default initializers, and message descriptors for `fd_exec_test_cost_tracker_t`, `fd_exec_test_block_context_t`, `fd_exec_test_leader_schedule_effects_t`, `fd_exec_test_block_effects_t`, and `fd_exec_test_block_fixture_t`. The file groups input data, execution results, and fixture metadata so test code can encode and decode block-level state with nanopb. It also includes size limits and name mappings that support generated serialization code and backward compatibility with older nanopb usage.
